e491dfa958fb8ebf437a1ce367e98d624a9371a7.summary: A DataBreaches news report from November 2023 says the AlphV group listed MeridianLink, a loan origination software provider for financial institutions, on its leak site after an attack on November 7. AlphV says it exfiltrated files without encrypting them and filed an SEC complaint alleging MeridianLink missed the four-business-day disclosure deadline. MeridianLink says it identified a cybersecurity incident on November 10, contained it, found no evidence of unauthorized access to production platforms, and its investigation is ongoing.
